idea.title: #10 THE 40-SECOND FILM
trending: PCMag demands $12000 to link to an article
Microsoft Outlook/365 still down after 12 hours

hooks: Ek single strong image — koi dialogue nahi.
Ek khaali kursi. Ek adha likha letter. Ek band darwaza.
Situation 4 second mein saaf ho jaani chahiye — bina bole.
Aakhri frame pehle frame ka echo ho, par meaning badla hua.
